title: Extremely Sparse-View Computed Tomography from 2D Projections via Pose-Aware Diffusion Priors
abstract: arXiv:2610.38319v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Extremely sparse-view computed tomography (xSV-CT) is critical when scanning time, motion, or radiation tolerance limits each scan to only a few projections. In many such scenarios, the same acquisition limits also constrain dataset construction, making pre-reconstructed 3D volumes from dense scans unavailable. This exposes a gap in current sparse-view approaches: Optimization-based methods, which use the sparse measurements directly but lack data-driven priors to suppress artifacts, and learning-based methods, which use strong priors but usually require densely scanned training volumes acquired outside the xSV-CT regime. We study this train-sparse / infer-sparse setting by learning a pose-aware diffusion prior from one 2D projection per training sample, then guiding diffusion sampling with measured-view fidelity, shared-volume reprojection, and projection-physics consistency for tomographic reconstruction. translated_title: 基于姿态感知扩散先验的从二维投影实现极稀疏视角计算机断层扫描
translated_abstract: 极稀疏视角计算机断层扫描在扫描时间、运动或辐射耐受性将每次扫描限制为仅少数几个投影时至关重要。在许多此类场景中，相同的采集限制也约束了数据集的构建，使得无法获得来自密集扫描的预重建3D体积。这暴露了当前稀疏视角方法的一个空白：基于优化的方法直接使用稀疏测量但缺乏数据驱动先验来抑制伪影，而基于学习的方法虽然使用强先验，但通常需要在xSV-CT范围之外采集的密集扫描训练体积。我们研究了这种“稀疏训练/稀疏推断”的设置，通过从每个训练样本的单个2D投影中学习姿态感知扩散先验，然后利用测量视角保真度、共享体积重投影和投影物理一致性来引导扩散采样，从而进行断层重建。在两个公开CT数据集上的实验……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种姿态感知扩散先验方法，仅需每个训练样本的单个2D投影即可学习先验，并通过视角保真度、共享体积重投影和投影物理一致性约束引导扩散采样，在无需密集扫描训练数据的情况下实现了极稀疏视角CT重建。
